subject: Update on Encord's New Beta Features
text:
Hi Paddy and Guillaume,

We are thrilled to announce the release of *four new Beta features*
designed to deliver a tighter, more seamless experience between our *Active*
and *Annotate* products. These updates are a significant step toward our
vision of moving all Active workflows directly into your projects, making
your curation, validation and task management processes more efficient than
ever.

✨* What’s New:*

   - *New Grid Queue *View: We’ve introduced a new visual interface for
   your queues, complete with* filters *and* queue actions*, giving you
   immediate visual context and greater control over task management. (Visible
   to all Org Admins)
   [image: image.png]

   - *New Visual Project Explore*: Built specifically to enhance your *label
   validation workflows*, this new interface includes *filters, analytics,
   embeddings*, and *direct actions* to help you quickly explore, validate
   and act on data. (Visible to all Org Admins)
   [image: image.png]

   - *Incremental Sync*: Say goodbye to manual syncing! Your tasks and
   labels will now *automatically sync* between Active and Annotate. This
   sync is triggered instantly on key task actions (Move, Assign, Submit,
   Reject, Approve, Prioritize).
   -
*Note: Metrics, Embeddings, and Reductions still require manual triggering
      via the Metric & Embedding config in the top right. *
   - *Act Upon Selections**:* You no longer need to constantly create and
   manage collections. You can now take direct actions on any selection within
   your project, speeding up your workflows.

We are striving for a future where *Active becomes obsolete* because all
its workflows have been successfully integrated into your projects.

feedback so we can continue building a better product together.

   within your projects?
